importantNote: Reduced zoom level in Search and Playlist pages to 92% with 108.6956% width calculation to eliminate side and bottom gaps.

changelog.category: Search & Playlist Zoom & Gapless Canvas Optimization (v1.8.3)
items: Applied 92% zoom scale scoped to Search page (.spotify-search-page) and Playlist page (.spotify-playlist-view).
Applied 108.6956% canvas width calculation to ensure zero side gaps and zero bottom gaps when zoomed.
Preserved 100% of music streaming backend logic.
Bumped service worker cache version to v120.
